006-12. BUT THAT THEY COULDN'T SEE THEIR FACES.
006-13. I'VE BEEN HAVING STRANGE DREAMS FORA YEAR.
006-14. VERY OMINOUS.
006-15. EVERYTHING WAS ENDING IN THE DREAMS.

007-1. THE EMPIRE,
007-2. THE FOUR RENOWNEDFAM- ILIES'CITY,
007-3. AND THE SMALL AND BIG CITIES AND VILLAGES.

007-6. THAT AT THIS RATE, THE CONTI- NENT WAS GOING TO MEET ITS END.

007-15. THE POWER TO SAVE THE WORLD.

008-10. I'LL PAY YOU WHATEVER YOU WANT.

008-12. NO. LOOK FOR SOMEONE ELSE.
008-13. YOU CAN JUST HIRE SOME OTHER CAPABLE PERSON IF YOU HAVE MONEY.
008-14. NO ONE BELIEVED ME WHEN I TALKED ABOUT MY DREAMS.
008-15. THEY DIDN'T EVEN WANT TO LISTEN TO ME.
008-16. BUT YOU WERE DIFFERENT.
008-17. YOU DIDN'T LAUGH AT MY STORY.
008-18. THAT IS WHY I WANT TO HIRE YOU.
